source_scope.authoritative_document: DWS语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.scope_rule: This slice covers candidate assets without an authoritative ODS domain that have a same-name CREATE in the DWS document. It specifies corrected derived metrics only; DWS never becomes Order, Payment, Inventory, Moderation, Risk, AI or Ledger authority.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name DWS CREATE plus explicit grain, window, denominator, source-event, dimensional-version, money/unit and correction rules.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production recomputation from governed canonical event denominators with exact window boundaries, independently checked counts/sums, late-data policy and zero unexplained differences.

order_buyer_window.grain: one tenant, buyer Principal, as_of_date and exact half-open rolling window
metric_rules: count distinct canonical order or order-item keys at the declared metric grain
derive created paid successful unpaid from versioned Order/Payment lifecycle events without double counting transitions
money uses integer minor units and ISO currency and never mixes currencies
platform and seller subsidy derive from immutable benefit funding allocations
category metrics use the category version effective at the chosen event time
window is [as_of_date-window+1d, as_of_date+1d) in one declared timezone
order_buyer_window.authority: This is an analytical projection only; it cannot mutate Order, Payment, Promotion or Catalog state.

refund_buyer_window.grain: one tenant, buyer Principal, as_of_date and exact half-open rolling refund window
metric_rules: count distinct after-sale cases and successful refund effects rather than source rows
refund amount comes from captured Payment refund effects in integer minor units and ISO currency
return logistics fee is separate from refunded merchandise and compensation
compensation count and amount are separate typed metrics with named funding authority
one-to-many compensation or shipment joins preaggregate before buyer aggregation
window and late-arrival restatement policy are explicit and identical across numerator and denominator
refund_buyer_window.authority: AfterSales, Payment, Return Fulfillment and Customer Service retain authority; DWS cannot infer success from status code 2 alone.

community_user_day.grain: one tenant, canonical Principal and local calendar day with separately aggregated content, interaction, appeal and live-session facts
metric_rules: preaggregate every source to user-day before joining to prevent Cartesian multiplication
duration requires paired session start/end, timezone, negative-duration rejection and overlap policy
publish reaction share comment appeal and selected counts use distinct immutable event keys
selection and appeal success require accepted versioned Moderation decisions
raw content, reports and actor identity remain restricted
a metric row never grants visibility, moderation or engagement effects
community_user_day.authority: Engagement and Moderation own source facts; DWS is a privacy-minimized analytical projection.

live_creator_day.grain: one tenant, creator Principal and local calendar day from preaggregated live sessions and settled tip effects
metric_rules: session duration uses distinct session ids and paired start/end events
gift quantity and monetary tip amount are different typed measures
tip money requires ISO currency, integer minor units and exact Payment/Ledger settlement references
refund reversal chargeback and compensation subtract through immutable entries
multiple rooms sessions gifts and payments preaggregate before creator join
viewer presence or gift intent never proves payment settlement
live_creator_day.authority: Community owns session context while Payment/Ledger owns money; DWS cannot settle or pay a creator.

platform_engine_hour.grain: one tenant, engine event code, governed optional campaign reference and exact UTC/local hour
metric_rules: request count uses stable request ids with retry and duplicate policy
distinct subject count uses pseudonymous Principal mapping rather than raw user ids
intercept requires versioned response/status dictionary and accepted Risk decision semantics
missing campaign remains null or explicit UNKNOWN and random skew salt is never persisted as identity
marketing classification comes from governed campaign mapping not numeric regex
parameter null rate uses a complete versioned expected-parameter denominator with zero-denominator policy
platform_engine_hour.authority: Engine metrics observe invocations only and cannot create campaign membership, Risk enforcement or business effects.

quality_ai_day.grain: one tenant, date, platform, category/brand version, identify type, method and immutable model version
metric_rules: one denominator row per governed identification case and attempt selection rule
AI judgment and human ground truth use versioned dictionaries and independent review lineage
accuracy miss false-kill and risk-intercept numerators expose their exact eligible denominators
confidence thresholds are policy versions rather than hard-coded universal truth
latency excludes missing/invalid values and declares percentile algorithm
AI or risk output never directly changes quality saleability refund or listing state
quality_ai_day.authority: AI Operations records attempts, Quality owns accepted review, Risk owns decision and owning domains apply effects.

token_user_day.grain: one tenant, canonical Principal and UTC/local calendar day from immutable invocation, quota-ledger, payment and behavior events
metric_rules: request and token counts use unique invocation attempts and provider usage evidence
input output and total token conservation is checked per invocation and model version
quota cost comes from immutable integer ledger entries and pricing version rather than DOUBLE sums
top-up money requires ISO currency, integer minor units and captured Payment reference
TPM RPM and average duration declare eligible denominator and zero/missing policy
username is not a stable join key for Skill downloads; use canonical Principal mapping
token_user_day.authority: Token Platform owns usage/quota, Payment owns top-up settlement and DWS cannot debit quota or create access entitlements.
